svg.title: Apple M5 Max localization benchmark
svg.desc: Compiled custom Metal achieves a 1.10 to 1.21 times speedup relative to compiled compositional MLX across all 9 measured geometries on Apple M5 Max with MLX 0.32.3. Widths: 128, 2048, 4096. Latencies include Python dispatch, output allocation, execution, and synchronization. 3 process sessions; primitive microbenchmark, not model performance.

g.text: Apple M5 Max · MLX 0.32.3 · 3 process sessions · 9 geometries · both paths compiled

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--muted)

g.text: Lower latency is better. Ratio = MLX / Metal; dots are medians of 3 session medians.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--muted)

g.text: Includes Python dispatch, output allocation, execution, and evaluation. Compilation warmup excluded.

g.text: Source: evidence/09-apple-mlx-consumer · Descriptive microbenchmark; no confidence interval or model-throughput claim.
